items.question: What is the age limit for young Emiratis to be included on federal government entity boards under the Emirati Youth Board Membership policy?
items.fact: Emirati Youth Board Membership requires Emiratis under 30 on boards.

items.question: How many applicants did the UAE Cabinet approve as Boards of Directors members for key federal entities on 3 February 2020 under the Emirati Youth Board Membership policy?
items.fact: Cabinet approved 33 youth board applicants on 3 February 2020.
